You begin by validating automated data pipelines and Power BI semantic models, ensuring data accuracy across Safety, Environmental, and Sustainability domains. From there, you shift into AI‑driven analytics, refining predictive models, experimenting with new features, and validating outputs against real-world EQS scenarios. Midday, you collaborate with stakeholders across Business Areas and IT to translate evolving EQS needs into scalable solutions. This could include designing a RAG‑enabled assistant to support reporting queries, enhancing anomaly detection models, or automating manual reporting processes using AI and advanced analytics. You continuously evaluate where AI can reduce effort, increase insight quality, and strengthen risk visibility. Throughout the day, you balance hands‑on development with strategic thinking—ensuring that everything you build is reusable, governed, and aligned to enterprise standards. You close your day by sharing knowledge—whether refining documentation, enabling colleagues through training, or shaping the next generation of EQS analytics capabilities. How You’ll Make An Impact You will play a key role in transforming EQS reporting from descriptive to predictive and intelligence‑driven. By embedding AI into our analytics ecosystem, you will help the organization move beyond historical reporting toward forward‑looking insights that support proactive risk management and decision‑making. Your work will improve the speed, quality, and scalability of EQS reporting—reducing manual effort, strengthening audit readiness, and enabling consistent global insights. You will also act as a technical reference point, elevating the capability of the entire team by introducing modern analytics approaches, reusable standards, and AI‑enabled solutions. What You Bring Bachelor’s degree in data Analytics, Information Systems, Engineering, Computer Science, Environmental Sciences, or a related field. Strong experience in data analytics, reporting, digital transformation, or business intelligence roles. Experience working with analytics and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI) and large, structured datasets. Strong analytical thinking with the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights. Effective communication skills to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders across global teams. Experience in EHS, Quality, Security, sustainability, or non-financial reporting environments is an advantage. Note: You bring deep expertise at the intersection of Power BI, AI, and data engineering, with the ability to design and deliver enterprise‑grade analytics solutions. You are comfortable working across the full data lifecycle—from pipeline design and semantic modeling to advanced AI applications such as machine learning models, LLMs, RAG architectures, and prompt engineering. Beyond technical capability, you bring strong judgment. You understand when AI adds value—and when it doesn’t. You can translate complex EQS and business needs into meaningful analytics, challenge assumptions constructively, and design solutions that are both scalable and practical. You communicate confidently, think critically, and naturally enable others by sharing knowledge, defining standards, and building reusable assets. About The Team You will join a global EQS Reporting team operating at the intersection of Environment, Health, Safety, Quality, and Security. The team is highly collaborative and works closely with Business Areas, IT, and Corporate Functions to deliver reliable, compliant, and forward‑looking reporting. As the function continues to evolve, the team is increasingly focused on digitalization and AI‑enabled reporting, with initiatives such as analytics automation, data product development, and AI‑powered insights shaping the roadmap. Title: Senior Analytics - Regulatory Solutions
Description: About Nu Nu is the leading digital bank in Latin America, serving 135 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The company has been leading an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services. Guided by its mission to fight complexity and empower people, Nu caters to customers’ complete financial journey, promoting financial access and advancement with responsible lending and transparency. The company is powered by an efficient and scalable business model that combines low cost to serve with growing returns. Nu’s impact has been recognized in multiple awards, including Time 100 Most Influential Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Banks. Visit our Institutional Page Regulatory Solutions Analytics at Nubank As a company at the forefront of the financial revolution in Latin America, Nubank has grown exponentially since its inception — and keeping that growth healthy and people-centered depends on making critical, data-informed decisions every day. Regulatory Solutions Analytics is at the heart of that process: our analysts work across teams to structure and analyze data, challenge assumptions, and translate findings into real improvements for our customers. As a Sr Analyst in Regulatory Solutions Analytics, you bring the depth, autonomy, and technical fluency to lead that work on the most demanding problems — and to raise the bar for the analysts around you. We’re looking for people who are curious, proactive, and energized by solving complex problems: not necessarily those with all the answers, but those who know how to find them. About The Role This role sits in Pack Analytics within Regulatory Solutions (Ops Defense). You’ll turn the analytical demands of our regulatory processes — KYC, AML, Judicial Orders, and others — into advanced analytics, models, and AI-powered solutions, while keeping the highest standard of quality for customer data and due diligence, in line with regulators and internal policies. You will operate with growing autonomy: you solve well-defined problems independently and take on harder, more ambiguous challenges with the support of your team and manager, beginning to build deep expertise in your domain. Above all, you are excellent with data and genuinely passionate about artificial intelligence, proactively keeping yourself at the frontier of what these tools can do. As a Sr Analyst in Regulatory Solutions Analytics, you’re expected to Lead investigative, data-first work end to end: decide which data makes the most sense in each situation and, when it isn’t there yet, design the right tests or approaches to generate it. Own advanced data analysis — run root-cause analysis, formulate and test hypotheses, and deliver effective solutions to challenging (though typically well-defined) problems with limited supervision. Apply data science and statistical methods (e.g., anomaly detection, classification, segmentation, forecasting) to strengthen, scale, and automate regulatory decisions. Use artificial intelligence as a core tool: leverage GenAI/LLMs and modern AI tooling to accelerate analysis, prototype solutions, and automate manual work — and proactively stay at the frontier of AI, bringing new techniques back to the team.
